title: UN Comtrade merchandise trade by HS commodity
description: Official country and partner trade records for goods, including aquatic products selected by Harmonized System commodity code. Query one reporter, period, commodity and flow at a time; annual and monthly data are supported.

variables.name: primaryValue
variables.description: Primary merchandise trade value; source CIF/FOB valuation depends on the country and flow.

variables.name: netWgt
variables.description: Net weight when available; this is product weight, not FishStat live weight.

variables.name: qty
variables.description: Primary quantity with its source unit, when available.

coverage.geography: Countries and areas in UN Comtrade reporter and partner reference lists
coverage.period: Reporter- and commodity-specific; verify returned records
coverage.classification: HS as reported or a selected HS edition H0-H6

access.authentication: Free UN Comtrade API subscription key required for downloads; set UN_COMTRADE_API_KEY. Reference-list search needs no key.
access.method: Official UN Comtrade data API and live reference lists

limitations: A free API subscription key is required. The free tier permits up to 100,000 records per call and 500 API calls per day; a result at the cap may be incomplete.
This connector retrieves one goods-trade selection at a time. It does not use premium bulk or tariff-line APIs.
UN Comtrade does not identify individual producer, buyer or supplier firms.
HS editions and product definitions can change over time. Aggregate and detailed HS codes must not be summed together.
UN Comtrade goods trade and FAO FishStat aquatic trade use different product classifications and weight bases; do not combine without a documented concordance.
